name: Toronto Maple Leafs
linesAsOf: Nov 8 vs NJD, forwards per Daily Faceoff (updated Nov 8) and New Jersey Hockey Now projection; defence projected with Mermis and McWard in for Rielly and Tanev (Toronto Hockey Daily, citing Mark Masters), pairs not confirmed

players.how: Signed a two-year deal as a free agent on July 1, 2026.
players.story: Scored an empty-net goal and added an assist in the 4-2 win at Vancouver.

players.how: Drafted 28th overall by Toronto in 2023.
players.story: Back on the top line with Matthews and Roslovic at Monday's practice. Had some early turnovers at Vancouver.

players.how: Signed a three-year deal as a free agent on July 1, 2026.
players.story: Energy forward from Florida who played all 82 games for Washington last season.

players.how: Signed by Toronto in 2025.
players.story: Groulx cleared waivers on Nov. 3 after Joshua returned. He was scoreless in seven games and had not played since Oct. 28.

players.how: Acquired from Vancouver in July 2025 for a 2028 fourth-round pick.
players.story: Moved to the third line with Sissons and McKenna at Friday's practice as Tavares rejoined the second line.

players.how: Signed by Toronto in 2026.
players.story: Scored at Vancouver on a point shot that deflected off Luke Schenn. It was his second goal as a Leaf.

players.how: Traded from Columbus on Sept. 28, 2026, with Miles Wood and Elvis Merzlikins for Matthew Knies, Steven Lorentz, Emil Andrae and a 2027 second-round pick. Then signed a six-year, $75M extension.
players.story: Marchenko left an Oct. 26 game against Calgary with a lower-body injury after a hit from Yegor Sharangovich. He had 14 points in 13 games and is projected back around Nov. 17.

players.how: Drafted 1st overall by Toronto in 2016.
players.story: Set up both Roslovic goals, the first after forcing a turnover behind the Utah net. He has a five-game point streak (three goals, five assists).

players.how: Drafted 1st overall by Toronto in 2026 out of Penn State.
players.story: Benched for the rest of the second period on Nov. 7 after a turnover led to Montreal's first goal. Scored in the third period 55 seconds after Nylander.

players.how: Drafted 8th overall by Toronto in 2014.
players.story: Scored a power-play goal and hit two posts in the 4-2 loss to Montreal. It was his 85th power-play goal as a Leaf, tying Tavares for fifth in team history.

players.how: Traded from Tampa Bay on July 1, 2026, for goalie Dennis Hildeby, a 2027 fourth and a 2028 third.
players.story: Centred Tavares and Nylander at Friday's practice and is on the second power-play unit.

players.how: Signed as a free agent on July 1, 2026.
players.story: Took a maintenance day Wednesday and was back on the top line with Cowan and Matthews at Friday's practice. He scored both goals in the 3-2 loss to Utah.

players.how: Signed a two-year, $8.5M deal as a free agent in 2026.
players.story: Longtime Nashville checking centre who spent last season in Vegas. Faceoffs and penalty killing.

players.how: Signed as a free agent in 2018 and has re-signed since.
players.story: Returned Nov. 7 after missing nine games with a lower-body injury and played left wing for the first time since April 2023, with Paul and Nylander. Had three shots in the loss to Montreal.

players.how: Came from Columbus in the Sept. 28, 2026, Marchenko trade.
players.story: Wood was moved to long-term injured reserve on Oct. 28 to open cap room for Dakota Joshua's return. He is not in the projected lineup for Saturday.

players.how: Signed after a training-camp tryout in 2026.
players.story: Blankenburg went on injured reserve in late October with an upper-body injury. InsideTheRink projects a return around Nov. 12.

players.how: Signed as a free agent in 2024.
players.story: Former Coyotes captain and 2009 sixth-overall pick, now 35. Won a Cup with Florida in 2024.

players.how: Traded from Chicago at the 2023 deadline.
players.story: Steady, physical defenceman paired with Raddysh. Was on the ice for three of Montreal's four goals on Nov. 7.

players.how: Signed by Toronto in 2026 after a season in the Islanders organization.
players.story: Recalled from the Marlies on Nov. 8 after Rielly's injury and projected to play his first game of the season against New Jersey.

players.how: Claimed off waivers from Utah in January 2025.
players.story: Projected to draw in Nov. 8 against New Jersey with Rielly and Tanev out.

players.how: Acquired from Tampa Bay in a sign-and-trade on June 19, 2026, with an eight-year contract.
players.role: Top-pair right defenceman and PP1 quarterback
players.story: Played 29:43 in the 4-2 loss to Montreal on Nov. 7 and is expected to take heavy minutes with Rielly out.

players.how: Drafted 5th overall by Toronto in 2012.
players.story: Left the Nov. 7 loss to Montreal after 5:45 with a lower-body injury and did not return. Reported out Nov. 8 against New Jersey; Hiller called it a big blow.

players.how: Signed as an undrafted free agent in 2023.
players.story: Rifai went on injured reserve in late October with a lower-body injury. Daily Faceoff lists him as out.

players.how: Re-signed for two years on June 29, 2026.
players.story: Was beaten on the rush on a Utah goal and broke his stick on a good scoring chance.

players.how: Acquired from Dallas in 2024 for his rights, then signed a six-year deal.
players.role: Second-pair right defenceman and penalty killer
players.story: Reported out Nov. 8 against New Jersey for planned maintenance, not an injury. He has played nine of Toronto's 18 games.

players.how: Drafted 106th overall by Toronto in 2020.
players.story: Third goalie. New Jersey Hockey Now projected him as Sunday's backup, but Daily Faceoff lists Bobrovsky.

players.how: Signed a three-year, $21M deal as a free agent on July 1, 2026.
players.story: Made 24 saves in the 4-2 loss to Montreal on Nov. 7. Stolarz is expected to start the second game of the back-to-back.

players.how: Signed as a free agent in 2024.
players.story: Expected to start Sunday against New Jersey on the back end of the back-to-back, per New Jersey Hockey Now.

players.how: Signed by Toronto as a free agent.
players.story: Sent to the AHL Marlies on Nov. 8 when Cole McWard was recalled.
